name: BUNN
fix_description: Exclude the LP pair address from reflection rewards (add pair to _isExcluded), or remove the deliver function. When deliver reduces _rTotal, it inflates the token balance of all holders including the LP pair, but the pair reserves are not synced, creating an arbitrage opportunity.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-pattern exploit against a reflection token mechanic: invoke the pair swap callback and call deliver() to reduce the pair’s token balance, then profit from the broken reserve accounting. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no flash loan orchestration, and the PoC is far under 100 lines with essentially one key external action.
